description: Nature is a broad field study of the natural world: how living things depend on each other, food chains, five fields of your choice from birds to soils and rocks, ecological succession, and careers that use nature skills.

versions.label: Checked against official scouting.org excerpts (partial verification)

provenance.notes: Requirement numbering and topics were checked against excerpts of official Scouting America pages (scouting.org) returned by a search index on 2026-10-24. The pages themselves could not be opened from the build environment, so wording was not compared word for word and some sub-items may be summarized from partial excerpts. Summaries are ScoutPath's own words. Requirements 1–3 (how living things depend on each other and food chains) and 5–6 (ecological succession and a natural-area visit) were summarized together in the excerpts and are not outlined separately yet.

references.label: Official merit badge page (scouting.org Merit Badge Hub)

requirements.title: Five fields of nature
requirements.summary: All the tasks in five fields, chosen from birds, mammals, reptiles and amphibians, insects and spiders, fish, mollusks and crustaceans, plants, and soils and rocks.

requirements.title: Careers or hobbies
requirements.summary: One option, centered on a career that uses nature skills.
